lessons: A stale number is more dangerous than a missing one: the blank proxy stopped the arithmetic and announced itself, the backfilled one restarted it with a market return that is an artefact of 500 shares.
A rule that names its own source beats a rule that names the outage; three cadence alerts on one missing slot were each independently actionable.
An alert can close because the machine recovered rather than because anyone acted, and the page has to say which.
A story about a different listing of the same issuer is a link, not a cause, and a gate keyed on the company name cannot tell them apart.
